raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Fix draft weight loading for Mistral EAGLE models, including [Mistral Small 4 EAGLE](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-Small-4-119B-2603-eagle).

## Claims

- Initialize the shared-expert state used by the inherited weight loader.
- Initialize `hidden_size`, which the inherited forward path reads during sequence-parallel gathering.

## Validation

CPU: five tests passed on `b14e2f279` plus this patch. Pre-commit passed, including mypy. The new regression constructs a real draft model and checks the loaded weight tensor.

| Test | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Draft weight loading | `AttributeError: 'EagleMistralLarge3Model' object has no attribute 'fused_shared_expert_layers'` | Loads the norm weight with exact tensor equality |

GPU: B200 x1 / TP1, Mistral Small 4 NVFP4 with its public EAGLE draft, vLLM `b14e2f279` plus this patch, PyTorch 2.14.0+cu130. Context 8192, GMU 0.85, max sequences 8, prefix caching off. Both patched runs used Model Runner V2.

| Configuration | Startup and generation | GSM8K smoke | Mean acceptance length |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Unpatched EAGLE, k=3 | Startup fails with the missing attribute above | — | — |
| Target only | Generates | 28/32 | — |
| Patched EAGLE, k=3, eager | Generates; nonzero draft acceptance | 28/32 | 3.25 |
| Patched EAGLE, k=3, non-eager | Generates; nonzero draft acceptance | 30/32 | 3.18 |

Acceptance length includes one target-generated token; its maximum is `k + 1`. The corresponding draft acceptance rates were 75.0% and 72.8%.

The smoke uses the first 32 GSM8K test questions, five-shot prompts, greedy decoding and a 512-token cap. No GSM8K response reached the cap. Generation was also checked on eight math/coding prompts at batches 1 and 8 with a 128-token cap. Greedy outputs differ between target-only and speculative decoding.

Public checkpoints: [NVFP4 target](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-Small-4-119B-2603-NVFP4/tree/45331841b631f4e281df8e959ea3cc9beb84298a), [EAGLE draft](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-Small-4-119B-2603-eagle/tree/9a8ea22dca0161ff7af7879f4a0000f65314797d).

<details>
<summary>CPU test commands</summary>

```bash
VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu .venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  tests/model_executor/test_mistral_large_3_eagle.py -q

.venv/bin/pre-commit run --files \
  vllm/model_executor/models/mistral_large_3_eagle.py \
  tests/model_executor/test_mistral_large_3_eagle.py
```

</details>

<details>
<summary>GPU reproducer</summary>

From a vLLM checkout with GPU dependencies installed:

```python
from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams
from tests.evals.gsm8k.gsm8k_eval import evaluate_gsm8k_offline

llm = LLM(
    model="mistralai/Mistral-Small-4-119B-2603-NVFP4",
    revision="45331841b631f4e281df8e959ea3cc9beb84298a",
    config_format="mistral", load_format="mistral", tokenizer_mode="mistral",
    tensor_parallel_size=1, max_model_len=8192,
    max_num_seqs=8, max_num_batched_tokens=8192,
    gpu_memory_utilization=0.85, enable_prefix_caching=False,
    disable_log_stats=False, generation_config="vllm", seed=42,
    enforce_eager=True,
    attention_config={"backend": "TRITON_MLA"},
    limit_mm_per_prompt={"image": 0},
    speculative_config={
        "model": "mistralai/Mistral-Small-4-119B-2603-eagle",
        "revision": "9a8ea22dca0161ff7af7879f4a0000f65314797d",
        "method": "eagle", "num_speculative_tokens": 3,
        "max_model_len": 8192,
    },
)
print(llm.chat(
    [{"role": "user", "content": "What is 17 multiplied by 23? Show the calculation."}],
    SamplingParams(temperature=0, max_tokens=128, seed=42),
))
print(evaluate_gsm8k_offline(llm, num_questions=32, num_shots=5, max_tokens=512))
print([metric for metric in llm.get_metrics() if "spec_decode" in metric.name])
```

Repeat with `enforce_eager=False` for non-eager execution. Omit `speculative_config` for the target-only reference. The checked-in loader regression runs in Model Executor CI; the real-weight 119B checks were run separately on B200.

</details>

## Details

`EagleMistralLarge3Model` inherits `load_weights` and `forward` from `DeepseekV2Model` but skips its constructor. The draft constructor does not initialize the shared-expert state that the weight loader reads, so loading fails even for a dense draft.

Use the same helper as the parent to derive fused shared-expert layers from the constructed model. This also preserves the parent's policy checks if a draft contains MoE layers.

Based on Ruben Debien's open [#61369](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61369), adapted to the per-layer shared-expert API introduced by [#61457](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61457). The earlier patch initializes the old boolean flag using a helper that no longer exists on main.

AI-assisted implementation and testing using Codex.

---

<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>
